description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans serialization, focusing on polymorphic serialization, custom exception serialization, and deep copying of class hierarchies. It defines several serializable classes with inheritance, tests serialization/deserialization round-trips, and verifies type preservation across serialization boundaries.

classes.name: CustomException
classes.description: A custom serializable exception class with additional integer property and serialization support.

classes.name: PolymorphismTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing polymorphic serialization, exception serialization, and deep copying in Orleans.

classes.name: TypeConfigurationProvider
classes.description: Configures well-known type IDs for polymorphic serialization.

classes.name: SomeBaseClass
classes.description: Base class with string and integer properties, marked for serialization.

classes.name: SomeSubClass
classes.description: Derived class extending SomeBaseClass with additional properties.

classes.name: OtherSubClass
classes.description: Another subclass extending SomeBaseClass with different properties.

classes.name: SomeSubClassChild
classes.description: Subclass of SomeSubClass with additional properties.

methods.name: ExceptionsAreSerializable
methods.description: Test method verifying serialization and deserialization of various exception types, including custom exceptions.

methods.name: GeneratedSerializersRoundTripThroughSerializer_Polymorphic
methods.description: Test method verifying round-trip serialization of a polymorphic class instance.

methods.name: GeneratedSerializersRoundTripThroughSerializer_PolymorphicMultiHierarchy
methods.description: Test method verifying round-trip serialization across multiple inheritance hierarchies.

methods.name: DeepCopyPolymorphicTypes
methods.description: Test method verifying deep copying of polymorphic class instances.

methods.name: RoundTripToExpectedType
methods.description: Helper method to serialize and deserialize an object, asserting type preservation.

methods.description: Helper method to perform deep copy of an object using the serializer.
